newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end higher with foreign markets.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end higher with foreign markets.

text.p: Portuguese shares ended higher in sympathy with foreign markets, recovering from yesterday's correction.

Portugal Telecom, cement group Cimpor and mobile phone operator Telecel resumed their positive trend. Banco Totta e Acores hit a high for 1997 of 3,220 escudos as investors looked forward to a healthy 1996 dividend payout. Domestic and international investors were active today in high turnover of 10.7 billion escudos.
* Dealers said that the trend tomorrow would depend on the close of Wall Street today.
